Chapter 61

"Who are you? You dare to assassinate this king, aren't you afraid of killing your nine clans?" Seeing such a large group of people surrounded him, Zhong Yu said coldly.

"Who are we? Hahaha, who are we? Can't you guess? Or maybe you have killed too many people, and you have too many enemies to guess!" A leader of the group of assassins laughed with tears Said crazily.

"Oh, it looks like you are the remnants of the gentry who I killed the whole clan. After you escaped by chance, you didn't hide in the corner with your tail between your legs and behaved well. You dare to come back, do you want me to kill you again? "Zhong Yu smiled and said to the group of assassins with great interest. Then without waiting for their answer, he muttered to himself again.

"No, no, even if you gathered all the traitors and fugitives in Bashu, you group of remnants, it is impossible to have more than 1,000 people. Even if there were, it is impossible to come to this Jiangling city without making a sound and not be killed by the lonely king." The people found out!" After a pause, he continued.

"There must be other forces joining. Is it the local gentry in Jiangling? After being found by you, the rabbit died and the fox participated in your conspiracy to assassinate the lonely king together?"

"Your Majesty is indeed very wise. He found out about our background so quickly. Yes, we are the local gentry in Jiangling. We don't want to rebel. It's just that the king doesn't give us a way out for the gentry." Standing in that mood Next to the somewhat unstable assassin leader, a leader-like person said

"In Nuoda's Yizhou Bashu land, under the king's decree, all the gentry were uprooted, and even the relatives who were separated by six clothes were not spared. We had no choice but to unite and fight for us. I'm fighting for a way to survive." At this point, the tone of the leader's words became a bit harsh and decisive.

"I see, is it because what I did in the past forced me too hard? That's right, rabbits bite people when they are in a hurry, let alone people? And they are people who hold great power!" Zhong Yu's tone was a little stunned Said.

"It's good that your majesty understands the truth that it's too late, but your majesty still didn't understand it before. If your majesty can relax a little bit, and even just need to give those aristocratic families a way to survive, how could it be so troublesome today?"

"But it's useless to say these things now. Your Majesty is already a dying person, and it seems useless to understand this truth." The assassin leader representing the local family said in a somewhat teasing tone.

"It's too late, yes, I've remembered this truth, and I must correct it in the future, so as not to make mistakes like this again!" Zhong Yu's tone was a little calm, and it could even be said to be relaxed.

"As expected of the King of Yuguo, who occupies the territory of the two states of the Han Dynasty, to be able to come to this point, the calmness and indifference in the face of death alone is beyond the reach of ordinary people! I don't want to humiliate a king too much, the king still hangs himself Come on, I'll leave you with a whole body!"

Seeing Zhong Yu's calm, even ignorant tone and expression, the representative of this aristocratic family showed a trace of embarrassment and indignation.

It seems that Zhong Yu's attitude of ignoring his existence, or treating him as an ant, stimulated his arrogance and self-esteem as a child of an aristocratic family, and he said impatiently.

"It's just a bunch of jumping clowns. This king can say a few words to you because your ancestors have prayed for blessings in the underworld for generations. If you dare to ask this king to hang himself and laugh the big teeth of the whole world, no one will You are so arrogant!" Zhong Yu sneered a few times when he heard the words of the head of the family.

"Do you think that you are still the king of the kingdom surrounded by tens of thousands of people? Now you are just a prisoner captured by us. How dare you speak to the existence that can rule your life and death? The king of the sky, did you make you so arrogant?" the leader said with some embarrassment.

"Oh, it seems that you really think you're going to get me. Well, now that you've figured out where these assassins came from? It's no fun to play any longer. Instead, you're wasting your time for no reason, and Lower your own style, let's end this boring game earlier!" Zhong Yu's boring voice came over.

Hearing Zhong Yuna's nonchalant words, the assassin leaders felt an inexplicable sense of crisis.

He hurriedly looked around and inspected carefully, but found nothing abnormal, especially the reinforcements.

The only possible reinforcements were the more than 200 besieged guards, but they had been strangled by the crowd and were completely lost. Only 30 or so people were still stubbornly resisting.

Immediately let go of the early heart, relieved, smiled and looked at Zhong Yu, and said with a smile.

"Is your majesty afraid? We deliberately organized reinforcements..."

Before the leader finished speaking, his mouth was opened there, and he stared in Zhong Yu's direction dumbfounded.

Following his gaze, he saw that there were only thirty or so guards around Zhong Yu, but now there were hundreds of them densely lined up. He didn't know where they came from, as if they just appeared out of thin air.

The surrounding assassins were equally stunned, and they all froze there, motionless. Some even wiped their eyes vigorously with their hands, as if they thought they were hallucinating.

"How? I just said it, do you think you can eat me? Now it's your turn to beg the lonely king!" Zhong Yu said jokingly.

"Kill me, don't let any of these traitors go, kill them all, I want everyone to understand the fate of opposing me!" Before they could answer the question just now, Zhong Yu couldn't wait, Immediately said harshly.

The soldiers around him immediately rushed out like water, and rushed towards those assassins, those enemies who were still a bit stupefied who were willing to let go after two or three hits.

In an instant, a large area was emptied around Zhong Yu, and hundreds of people fell down like this. The screams followed, one after another, wailing everywhere.

With the sound of those ruthless brakes, the leaders woke up instantly. No matter how those soldiers appeared, the most urgent task now is to kill the king of the imperial kingdom in front of them.

Otherwise, with the cruelty of this king, let him go back to Jiangling City, then he will definitely gather an army and bloodbath the entire gentry in Jiangling County. It will even spread to the entire Jingzhou, and then some people like myself will be the sinners of the entire Jingzhou family.

Several leaders looked at each other, nodded fiercely, made up their minds, whispered a few words to the surrounding confidants, and took the lead to rush up.

Take the lead by your own example to cheer up the Assassin Legion whose morale is already unstable because of those soldiers who suddenly appeared, thinking that the man in front of him has received help from heaven.

Those assassins are so desperate after seeing the honorable status of their masters, so why should they spare their lives for these lowly servants?

Morale, which was already a little low, suddenly lifted up, and followed suit. All of a sudden, he fought with five hundred ordinary soldiers summoned by Zhong Yu just through the system.

However, this was nothing more than a moment of courage. They held back such a breath in their hearts, and when they found out that they still couldn't take themselves down for such a long time, the breath would naturally dissipate.

And for an assassin who has lost such a bloody courage, his heart will drop, so how dare he spend his life against him at that time, it will definitely end up fleeing in all directions.

What's more, after such a long time, Jiangling City must have received the news that he was in an ambush, and the reinforcements will definitely arrive soon. By then, none of these assassins will try to escape.
